claim: Kanban features: projects, boards, lists, cards, real-time updates, Markdown, 100+ notification providers
Community vs Pro table: Pro adds phones and tablets, calendar, timeline, map views, recurring cards, templates, guest roles, SSO (OIDC), PDF and HTML export
Community includes webhooks, REST API, two-factor authentication, stopwatch and due dates
Pro upgrade is one-way, no downgrade, and accepts only certain Community releases (currently 2.1.x and 2.2.x)

Docker Compose install steps: secret key, BASE_URL, create admin user, docker compose up
Kubernetes install documented in the docs menu
